purpose: Sur La Table sells kitchen goods and provides bookable cooking classes. This clone covers public class discovery and local account-owned class bookings.
direct_observations: Primary navigation exposes Cooking Classes and leads to /cooking-classes/.
Store discovery ranks locations by distance and supports a cooking-class service filter.
In-store class results expose date, cuisine, class type, pagination, calendar view, price, seat limits, and sold-out states.
The observed class detail showed title, description, price, availability, policies, and a (2) Reviews label.
Sign-in exposes email and password. Registration exposes first name, last name, email, password guidance, an optional marketing choice, Terms, and Privacy links.
Anonymous access to /order-history redirects to sign-in.
The cooking-class FAQ states that changes made at least 48 hours before class start can receive a refund, gift card, or exchange. Changes inside 48 hours receive no refund, exchange, or store credit.
Unknown paths render a branded HTTP 410 recovery view with site navigation.
structural_evidence: First-party page families include public entry, cooking-class landing, in-store discovery, class detail, locations, account access, order history, help, and recovery.
Core objects are store, class definition, dated class session, local account, and booking.
inferences: A confirmed booking should belong to one authenticated account and reserve capacity in one dated class session.
Checkout totals use session price multiplied by party size because no observed evidence supported added tax, fees, deposits, discounts, or gratuity.
Local rescheduling and cancellation use the public 48-hour policy because source account-management views were inaccessible.
inaccessible_content: Source checkout review, payment, confirmation, authenticated history, reschedule, and cancellation views were inaccessible without making prohibited source mutations.
Review body text was inaccessible. Only the visible (2) Reviews label is preserved.
No Expanded Task Inventory workbook or connected Excel session was available.
